node.statement: Constant selection and the single upstream application: invoke lem-stage1-extra-fixed-class exactly once, obtaining universal C_fix>=1, e_fix^r>0 and r:=r_bidx>0 and, for every admissible algebra with epsilon_r<=e_fix^r, its displayed U in calU_e satisfying sigma(U)=U, ||U-U^dagger||<=C_fix*epsilon_r, and ||U-J||,||U+J||>=r. Define K:=3+4*C_fix/r, C_bridge:=max{C_fix,K}, and e_bridge^r:=min{e_fix^r,1/2,1/C_fix,r/C_fix}; these are universal with C_bridge<infinity and e_bridge^r>0.
